recipes.title: Duck Breast with Orange Sauce
recipes.description: A classic French dish featuring pan-seared duck breast served with a tangy orange sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

method.title: Cook the Duck
method.description: Score the skin of the duck breast, season with salt and pepper. Place skin-side down in a cold pan and turn the heat to medium. Cook for about 6-8 minutes until the skin is crispy. Flip and cook for another 4-5 minutes for medium rare. Rest before slicing.

method.title: Make the Sauce
method.description: In a saucepan, combine orange juice, honey, soy sauce, and orange zest. Simmer until slightly thickened.

method.title: Prepare the Vegetables
method.description: Blanch the green beans in boiling water for 3-4 minutes until tender. Drain and season with salt.

method.title: Serve
method.description: Slice the duck breast and serve with the orange sauce drizzled on top, alongside the green beans and boiled potatoes.

recipes.title: Venison Chilli
recipes.description: A hearty and warming chilli made with lean venison, beans, and spices, perfect for a family meal.

method.title: Sauté the Base
method.description: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened. Stir in the minced garlic and diced pepper, cooking for another 2-3 minutes.

method.title: Cook the Venison
method.description: Add the venison mince to the pot, cooking until browned. Season with salt, pepper, chilli powder, and cumin.

method.title: Add the Tomatoes and Beans
method.description: Stir in the chopped tomatoes and kidney beans. Bring to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

method.title: Serve
method.description: Taste and adjust seasoning as necessary. Serve hot with bread or rice.

recipes.title: Tofu Stir-Fry with Broccoli and Peppers
recipes.description: A quick and healthy stir-fry featuring marinated tofu, broccoli, and bell peppers, served over rice.

method.title: Marinate the Tofu
method.description: In a bowl, mix soy sauce, sesame oil, minced garlic, and grated ginger. Add cubed tofu and let it marinate for at least 10 minutes.

method.title: Stir-Fry the Vegetables
method.description: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the marinated tofu and cook until golden. Add chopped broccoli and sliced bell pepper, stir-frying for 5-7 minutes.

method.title: Serve
method.description: Serve the stir-fry over cooked rice and garnish with sliced spring onions and black sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Rabbit Stew with Root Vegetables
recipes.description: A comforting stew made with tender rabbit, carrots, and potatoes, simmered in a rich broth.

method.title: Sauté the Vegetables
method.description: In a large pot, heat olive oil and sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until fragrant.

method.title: Brown the Rabbit
method.description: Add the cubed rabbit meat, browning on all sides. Season with salt and pepper.

method.title: Add Vegetables and Stock
method.description: Stir in the sliced carrots and diced potatoes. Add the chicken stock, bay leaf, and thyme.

method.title: Simmer
method.description: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes until the rabbit is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.

method.title: Serve
method.description: Remove the bay leaf and serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
